title: 07 · parvati_test · Parvati's Test
lines: A young monk walked up to Parvati and insulted Shiva to her face.
He had no idea what she had given up for him.
she left the palace to win the one god who wanted nothing.
She sat between five fires in summer.
She stood in ice water in winter.
She stopped eating fruit. Then leaves.
They named her Aparna: she who gave up even a leaf.
Shiva? He is a beggar. He sleeps in graveyards. He wears snakes.
"Shiva? He is a beggar. He sleeps in graveyards. He wears snakes.
You know nothing of him. Leave.
And she turned to walk away.
The monk was gone. Shiva stood there, smiling.
From today, he said, I am yours. Bought by your tapas.
"From today," he said, "I am yours. Bought by your tapas."
The last test is always the same. Someone tells you it was not worth it.
